message.content: Yes, after Emily Burnett initiated a vote on the most hateable character in Game of Thrones, the group engaged in a lively discussion about their favorite antagonists from the series. Several characters were mentioned as particularly disliked by the participants, with Joffrey Baratheon, Ramsay Bolton, and Cersei Lannister being the top contenders. The conversation was rich with detailed descriptions of why these characters were considered the most hateable. For instance, Niamh described Joffrey as having "cruelty on another level," while Orion highlighted Ramsay’s "sadistic nature" as the main reason for his dislike. Tamara added that Cersei was "manipulative and arrogant," driving her to "crazy" levels of frustration. These discussions not only revealed the personal preferences of the group but also showcased the complex and often controversial personalities of the characters in Game of Thrones.
